intro: LockBit appeared most frequently across the 58 articles on ZCyberNews, with The Gentlemen and ShinyHunters also covered. Reporting spanned April 12 to July 31, 2026, and referenced CVE-2026-1731, CVE-2026-34197, CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Healthcare, manufacturing, government, and education were among the affected sectors, with incidents noted in North America, the United States, Europe, and Turkey. The coverage included 42 high-severity and 6 critical items, alongside 1 medium and 2 informational reports.
